name: Judgemental
overview: Scripture warns against a judgmental spirit, emphasizing that judging others often leads to self-condemnation since those who judge do the same things they criticize (Romans 2:1). Believers are called to receive the weak in faith without engaging in doubtful disputes or passing judgment on their uncertain thoughts (Romans 14:1). Jesus teaches that refraining from judgment and condemnation invites forgiveness and freedom from being judged (Matthew 7:1; Luke 6:37). Wisdom literature contrasts pride with patience, highlighting that a proud, judgmental heart lacks understanding and delights in self-exposure rather than growth (Proverbs 18:2; Ecclesiastes 7:8).
